description: This file defines server plugin logic for the openclaw project, including gateway context management, plugin policies, and plugin runtime dispatch functions.

classes.name: FallbackGatewayContextState
classes.description: Manages fallback gateway request context for non-WebSocket paths.

classes.name: PluginSubagentOverridePolicy
classes.description: Defines override policies for plugin subagents regarding model access.

methods.name: getFallbackGatewayContextState
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton state for fallback gateway context.

methods.name: setFallbackGatewayContext
methods.description: Sets the fallback gateway request context.

methods.name: setFallbackGatewayContextResolver
methods.description: Sets the resolver function for fallback gateway context.

methods.name: getFallbackGatewayContext
methods.description: Gets the current fallback gateway request context.

methods.name: normalizeAllowedModelRef
methods.description: Normalizes a raw model reference string.

methods.name: setPluginSubagentOverridePolicies
methods.description: Configures override policies for plugin subagents based on plugin configuration.

methods.name: authorizeFallbackModelOverride
methods.description: Checks if fallback provider/model override is authorized based on policies.

methods.name: resolveRequestedFallbackModelRef
methods.description: Resolves a provider/model reference into a normalized string.

methods.name: createSyntheticOperatorClient
methods.description: Creates a synthetic client object for internal gateway requests.

methods.name: hasAdminScope
methods.description: Checks if a client has admin scope.

methods.name: canClientUseModelOverride
methods.description: Determines if a client is authorized to override models.

methods.name: dispatchGatewayMethod
methods.description: Dispatches a gateway method call with context and handles response.

methods.name: createGatewaySubagentRuntime
methods.description: Creates runtime functions for plugin subagents, including session management and run control.

methods.name: loadGatewayPlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes gateway plugins based on configuration and environment.
